title_en: Stories of Modern China (19/20): The Nose That Smells Rain
note_en: Doubling a verb makes an action sound brief and casual: 闻一闻 "take a sniff," 问问她 "go ask her," 摇摇头 "shake one's head." A one-syllable verb can also take 一 in the middle (闻一闻 = 闻闻). English gets the same light tone with phrases like "take a sniff" or "have a look."
